section_or_rule_title: Schemes (Employees' Provident Fund, Pension, and Insurance)
legal_status_notes: In force w.e.f. 21 November 2025 vide S.O. 5323(E). Replaced Section 5 of EPF Act 1952.

exact_text:
(1) The contribution which shall be paid by the employer to the Fund shall be ten per cent. of the wages for the time being payable to each of the employees (whether employed by him directly or by or through a contractor), and the employee's contribution shall be equal to the contribution payable by the employer in respect of him:
Provided that the Central Government may, by notification, specify twelve per cent. for certain establishments.
(2) The employer shall pay employee's contribution that is so deducted by him from the wages of the employee, into the Fund within such period as may be specified in the Provident Fund Scheme.
legal_status_notes: In force w.e.f. 21 November 2025. 10% or 12% statutory PF contributions.

exact_text:
(1) Gratuity shall be payable to an employee on the termination of his employment after he has rendered continuous service for not less than five years,—
(a) on his superannuation; or
(b) on his retirement or resignation; or
(c) on his death or disablement due to accident or disease; or
(d) on termination of his contract period under fixed term employment; or
(e) on happening of any such event as may be notified by the Central Government:
Provided that the completion of continuous service of five years shall not be necessary where the termination of the employment of any employee is due to death or disablement or expiration of fixed term employment:
Provided further that in the case of fixed term employment or a deceased employee, the employer shall pay gratuity on pro rata basis:
Provided also that in the case of working journalist, the expression 'five years' shall be read as 'three years'.
(2) For every completed year of service or part thereof in excess of six months, the employer shall pay gratuity to an employee at the rate of fifteen days' wages based on the rate of wages last drawn by the employee concerned.
legal_status_notes: In force w.e.f. 21 November 2025. Extends gratuity to fixed-term employees pro-rata without 5-year barrier. 15 days wages per completed year of service on resignation/retirement.

exact_text:
For the purposes of this Chapter,—
(1) an employee shall be said to be in continuous service for a period if he has, for that period, been in uninterrupted service...
(2) where an employee is not in continuous service for one year, he shall be deemed to be in continuous service if he has actually worked under the employer for not less than 240 days (190 days in mines or 5-day week establishments).
legal_status_notes: In force w.e.f. 21 November 2025. 240 days rule.

section_or_rule_title: Determination and payment of amount of gratuity
exact_text:
(1) A person who is eligible for payment of gratuity under this Chapter shall send a written application to the employer...
(2) As soon as gratuity becomes payable, the employer shall, whether an application has been made or not, determine the amount of gratuity and give notice in writing to the employee and competent authority...
(3) The employer shall arrange to pay the amount of gratuity within thirty days from the date it becomes payable.
(4) If the amount of gratuity is not paid within thirty days, the employer shall pay simple interest at the rate notified by the Central Government from the date it became payable to the date of payment.
legal_status_notes: In force w.e.f. 21 November 2025. Mandates payment within 30 days and simple interest on delay.

exact_text:
(1) The following Acts are hereby repealed, namely:— (c) the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952; (f) the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972...
(2) Notwithstanding such repeal, anything done or any action taken under the enactments hereby repealed shall, in so far as it is not inconsistent with the provisions of this Code, be deemed to have been done or taken under the corresponding provisions of this Code.
(3) The mention of particular matters in this section shall not be held to prejudice or affect the general application of section 6 of the General Clauses Act, 1897 with regard to the effect of repeal.
legal_status_notes: Operative w.e.f. 21 November 2025. Repealed Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 and EPF Act 1952 subject to savings.
